content.comment_body: Hello, I was able to configure email sending from my [product_name] [version_no] [article_no] using Gmail (once you get past all the security requirements, it is fairly straightforward). Triggering the email by an event is very simple. However, I could not find a method to send dynamic text—such as including internal values or variables in the email body prepared within the [product_name]. Is there a solution for this, aside from sending separate information via the web server? Best regards, [user_name] P.S. The [company_name] support server at [url] frequently generates internal server errors: [url]. Is this expected? Sometimes the same link will work fifteen minutes later—or not at all. (Split from topic about email sending in [product_name] [version_no])

I am not aware of any way to include dynamic text or values in email delivery from [product_name]. Additionally, [company_name] may be reserving such features for future updates to [product_name] [version_no].

analysis.insight_summary: The user successfully set up email notifications using Gmail from [product_name], but notes a key limitation—the lack of support for including dynamic content, such as internal variable values, in the email body. This restricts the communication of real-time data or status information via email. Another user suggests that dynamic text capability may be introduced in later versions, emphasizing the current constraint on usability and flexible data reporting.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects a way to include dynamic content, such as internal variable values, in the body of emails sent from [product_name].
pain_keywords: lack of dynamic text in email
